items.details: This guide follows a normal campaign with selected optional coverage. For all four main endings on one save, finish Weaver Queen before accepting the curse, then Twisted Child while cursed, complete Infestation Operation, and only then use the Soul Snare for Snared Silk. Loading that ending commits this file to Act III: Grand Mother Silk and the Act II endings cannot be replayed afterward. Continue to Sister of the Void and, for the Herald extension, finish his ordered wish before another final victory. Changing app routes never rewinds the world, removes a cure, creates a save backup or resets the timer. Shared checks record guide coverage across attempts. Profiles D/E are full-completion-ready Act III paths; A/B/C omit their later cleanup. The four heart plans choose three of four valid hearts before the ritual; changing a plan does not replace hearts already consumed. Timed runs and Steel Soul are separate attempts, with Steel Soul outside the native trophy list.

details_i18n.pt: Este guia segue uma campanha normal com conteúdo opcional selecionado. Para os quatro finais principais no mesmo salvamento, conclua Weaver Queen antes de aceitar a maldição, depois Twisted Child ainda amaldiçoada, complete Infestation Operation e só então use Soul Snare para Snared Silk. Carregar esse final compromete o arquivo com o Ato III: Grand Mother Silk e os finais do Ato II não podem ser repetidos depois. Continue até Sister of the Void e, para a extensão do Herald, conclua seus encontros ordenados antes de outra vitória final. Trocar rotas no aplicativo não retrocede o mundo, remove uma cura, cria cópias de salvamento ou reinicia o relógio. As marcações registram cobertura do guia entre tentativas. D/E são caminhos do Ato III preparados para a conclusão completa; A/B/C omitem essa limpeza posterior. Os quatro planos de corações escolhem três dos quatro válidos antes do ritual; trocar o plano não substitui corações já consumidos. Corridas de tempo e Steel Soul são tentativas separadas; Steel Soul não integra a lista nativa de troféus.

items.details: Bind is a committed healing action, not the first game's slow Focus. Build enough silk with safe needle attacks, create distance or wait for a long enemy recovery, then finish the action without interruption. Your equipped Crest can change what Bind does, so test a new Crest near a bench before relying on familiar healing behavior in a boss fight.

details_i18n.en: Bind is a committed healing action, not the first game's slow Focus. Your equipped Crest can change what Bind does, so test a new Crest near a bench before relying on familiar healing behavior in a boss fight.
details_i18n.pt: Bind é uma cura comprometida, não o Focus lento do primeiro jogo. Reúna seda com golpes seguros de agulha, crie distância ou espere uma recuperação longa do inimigo e conclua a ação sem interrupção. O Crest equipado pode alterar o funcionamento de Bind; teste um Crest novo perto de um banco antes de depender da cura habitual contra um chefe.

If afflicted, first finish any desired Twisted Child ending, then visit Yarnaby's locked Bellhome in Greymoor. Obtain Steel Spines from Crull and Benjin in Sinner's Road for 160 Rosaries in Act II, or from their later remains in Act III, and return for surgery. The cure is permanent and grants Witch Crest. D/E deliberately include the infestation/cure chain for their full-Crest cleanup baseline; B excludes the cure and must remain cursed for its finale. Lost Lace and Eva cannot be approached normally while cursed.

guides.body: Hornet moves and heals differently from the first game's Knight. Bind is a committed action, so create distance or wait for a clear enemy recovery rather than healing immediately after every hit. Check your current Crest because some change the healing behavior. Boss attacks can cover the space you just left; learn the next safe landing as well as the initial dodge. A short reliable damage window is more useful than a long combo that costs several masks.

guides.body: The starting Hunter Crest's downward attack is diagonal, so copying the first Hollow Knight's straight-down timing can miss a target. Practice the angle on ordinary enemies near a safe checkpoint. Other Crests change the moveset and can make different encounters or platform sections more comfortable. Keep enough space to recover after a bounce instead of pressing another attack before seeing the landing. A Crest switch is a deliberate loadout choice, not a universal damage upgrade.

guides.body: Tools use different slot colors and roles. Some are active consumable weapons; others modify combat, movement or utility.
